verdict.rationale: Qodo does not publish a traditional REST/OpenAPI public API (all openapi.json/swagger candidates 404'd), but it does expose documented programmatic interfaces for agentic use: an official CLI and an MCP server with live, auth-gated endpoints (bearer-required JSON-RPC gateway), letting AI agents retrieve findings, rules, and trigger reviews. This covers the spirit of 'driving the product programmatically' but not via a conventional public API contract. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI spec, independent third-party corroboration of API usage beyond docs/probes.
